name: suowang
description: SUOWANG is a local-first mainline cockpit for real life.
author: SUOWANG contributors

scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run desktop:bootstrap && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: npm run test:desktop:unit && npm run test:desktop:e2e
scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/app.js && node --check src/api.js && node --check src/view-model.js && node --check src/visual-assets.mjs && node --check desktop/main.js && node --check desktop/desktop-policy.mjs && node --check desktop/window-state.mjs && node --check scripts/audit-electron-security.mjs && node --check scripts/audit-public-surface.mjs && node --check scripts/build-icons.mjs && node --check scripts/cli.mjs && node --check scripts/create-mirror-manifest.mjs && node --check scripts/create-upgrade-fixture.mjs && node --check scripts/install-electron-runtime.mjs && node --check scripts/launcher-config.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && node --check scripts/serve.mjs && node --check scripts/smoke-temp.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-node-download.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-package.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-upgrade-fixture.mjs && node --check src/server/app-meta.mjs && node --check src/server/app-server.mjs && node --check src/server/config.mjs && node --check src/server/database.mjs && node --check src/server/instance-lock.mjs && node --check src/server/launcher-policy.mjs && node --check src/server/service.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run test:desktop && npm run desktop:package && node scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run smoke:temp && npm run test:desktop:unit && npm run package:check && npm run audit:public && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.release:windows: npm run release:check && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows-release.ps1 -UseBundledNapiPrebuild
